rationale: The stock gapped up ~7.6% on strong earnings and hit a high of $66.20 before pulling back sharply to $57.07, now sitting at only 38.8% of today's range and well below both VWAP ($61.36) and the 9-EMA ($59.67), indicating significant selling pressure from the morning highs. The last few 1-minute candles show accelerating downside volume (95k shares on the drop candle) with price failing to recover, suggesting the post-earnings euphoria has faded and the stock is in a distribution phase. With 129 minutes to close, no clear support level established, and the current price in no-man's land between the low and VWAP, the risk/reward for either direction is unfavorable — a long faces overhead supply from VWAP and EMA, while a short risks a bounce given the broad market strength (SPY +1.77%, VIXY -9.44%).
